label: CKD review: Varenicline above 1 mg/day in severe CKD before end stage and without dialysis
title: Varenicline above 1 mg/day in severe CKD before end stage and without dialysis
statement: For an outpatient aged 18 or older with established CKD, review varenicline above 1 mg/day at creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min if the person has neither end-stage kidney disease nor dialysis during that dose period.

plain_summary: For an outpatient aged 18 or older with established CKD, review varenicline above 1 mg/day at creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min if the person has neither end-stage kidney disease nor dialysis during that dose period.

medicine_groups.name: Varenicline
medicine_groups.note: Use the labelled varenicline strength and the schedule at the date of supply. Exclude dialysis regimens.

needs_facts.meets: Use a dated unindexed creatinine clearance in mL/min applicable during stable kidney function in this dose period. Below 30 meets and 30 or higher excludes. Unknown timing, unstable kidney function with an unreliable result, or indexed eGFR alone leaves clearance unresolved.

needs_facts.what: CKD and end-stage status during the varenicline dose period
needs_facts.meets: A dated record or a pharmacist answer confirming the stage for this dose period must establish outpatient CKD before end stage. A record of CKD alone leaves the stage and timing uncertain. End-stage disease or confirmed absence of CKD excludes this finding.

options.words: Established CKD had not reached end stage

needs_facts.what: Dialysis during the varenicline dose period under review
needs_facts.meets: Not receiving dialysis during the dose period under review meets this requirement. Receiving dialysis during that period excludes this finding. Not known leaves dialysis unresolved.

rule_for_models: For each varenicline stage in an outpatient aged 18 or older, multiply tablet strength by tablets per dose and doses per day. Report a finding only above 1 mg/day with established CKD before end stage, no dialysis and a reliable dated unindexed creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min during that stage. Cite the supply and qualifying renal evidence. Accept dated notes under the original kidney and dialysis labels. Use a dialysis answer only for the dose period it describes. If status changed or it is unclear which period the answer describes, use dated evidence for each exposure. If dialysis is unresolved and could change the decision, report only a possible finding naming "Dialysis during the varenicline dose period under review". One note may establish several facts. A generic CKD answer alone does not establish stage or timing. Give no finding if any requirement fails. If the stage could qualify but age, dose, dates, outpatient CKD stage, dialysis or clearance is unknown, cite available evidence and ask for the missing detail as a possible finding. A starter pack alone does not establish the dose. An undated result, indexed eGFR or unreliable clearance during unstable kidney function does not establish the threshold.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish the dose taken. Kidney results obtained elsewhere, their units and their timing may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the varenicline dose at this stage of titration and review it against creatinine clearance, kidney disease stage and dialysis status at the time?
